title: Elliptic corrections in the original boundary energy norm
source_hypothesis: Compact L2 source with all compressed L2 orders on one fixed neighborhood of a nonzero tangential boundary covector; full smooth ordinary operator of order below minus one half, and order minus two for the actual H1 conclusion.
reviewed_arguments: M0 retains the actual compact L2 source, one fixed compressed-regular neighborhood, the strict ordinary threshold m<-1/2, matrix symbols, strong normal support and all proper/base remainders.
M1 keeps the ordinary output base as a parameter and proves every Euler-profile L2 bound. Translation and scaling give uniform moving-center estimates as the output approaches the boundary.

M2 proves zero-extension commutation with xD_x by a vanishing boundary-layer error. Full ordinary commutators preserve order; the compressed elliptic differential operator recovers arbitrary test orders from all differential words.

M3 derives the complete triple-kernel phase and both densities. On y/x<=128 the bounded field (y/x)d_t+d_r cancels the ordinary normal phase exactly. The retained input/output frequency separation gives a quantitative gap for either sign of normal frequency.
M4 handles y/x>=64 by the exact separation s>=3y/16. Every differentiated profile is controlled by Euler derivatives without replacing its interior value by a boundary trace.

M5 estimates low and high input normal frequencies and near and far tangential frequencies. All frequency volumes, cutoff derivatives and residual terms are retained. Uniform L2 profile limits give the actual Hilbert-Schmidt kernel, identified on the original L2 source by density.

The chosen elliptic tester cones are independent of the requested order. Full compressed division establishes all-order L2 regularity on one fixed smaller neighborhood, not a sequence of shrinking neighborhoods.

M6 applies the theorem also to D_xA and D_zA of order minus one. The complete normal compressed commutator includes its order-minus-one coefficient multiplying the actual normal derivative. This proves the original unweighted H1 target.

M7 checks the exact full normal-cap correction QE from LG:L7 and proves equality of the original and corrected compressed H1 wave-front sets at every finite real order. It does not infer a smooth Dirichlet value for the Neumann/Robin problem.

Three complete solutions verify the elementary profile powers, both overlap constants, and an H2 function with zero actual traces but a divergent third tangential derivative. Twenty-eight exact checks supplement the analytic proofs.

Eleven overlapping desktop captures, the complete quantitative figure and two mobile samples were inspected. All 269 formulae parse, and all 29 numbered displays and figure extents remain accessible on mobile.

Twelve local entries bind to 1135 earlier entries in 67 maps, including 102 external Lebl providers. Incoming support, common-neighborhood propagation iteration, Neumann/Robin form control and the full original course objective remain active.
